QuestionStmt.S: The correct order of reactivity for reaction involving cleavage of C-X bond in following compounds is

Solution.S: Greater the number of electron withdrawing groups (e.g. $\mathrm{—NO_2}$) at ortho and para positions, greater is the reactivity of haloarenes involving breaking of C—X bond. Hence the correct order is III > II > I, which corresponds to option D.
